correctness.rationale: For the complete block 0 <= N < 3^L, the L ternary digits are independent and uniform. Legendre gives Y=s_3(N) since multiplying by 3 shifts digits; Kummer counts the outgoing carries of N+N, including a carry out of the highest sampled digit. An additional leading zero cannot produce a new carry. With incoming carry 0, digits 0,1 stay at 0 and digit 2 goes to 1; with incoming 1, digit 0 goes to 0 and digits 1,2 stay at 1. Weighting by u for an outgoing carry and v to the digit power gives the stated matrix and the endpoints (1,0) and (1,1)^T. For an independent covariance check, tilt each digit by weights 1,v,v^2; if q_j is the resulting digit probability, the carry probability obeys p_i=q_2+q_1 p_{i-1}. Hence p_i=[v^2/(1+v^2)](1-q_1^i). At v=1, d(q_1)/d(log v)=0 and the derivative of v^2/(1+v^2) equals its value, giving Cov(X,Y)=E X by differentiating the tilted E X. The carry transition has second eigenvalue 1/3, so Cov(c_i,c_j)=3^{-(j-i)}(1-3^{-2i})/4 for i<=j. Its geometric sum gives the stated exact variance; the independent digits give the moments of Y. For the CLT, tilt the matrix at u=e^s,v=e^t and divide by 3. Its simple leading eigenvalue is 1 at the origin, separated from 1/3. Locally the MGF is a leading eigenvalue to power L times an analytic prefactor equal to 1 at the origin, plus an exponentially small relative remainder. The second-order log expansion therefore uses the limiting per-L covariance in the record and yields its nondegenerate Gaussian limit; the bounded difference in the X center is immaterial. Independently replayed with Python 3 at /tmp/opencode/frozen_review_4.py: floor-sum factorial valuations for every input at each L=1..11, compared with polynomial propagation and exact rational moments. All matched (133 joint cells at L=11). This computational check is bounded; the digit argument establishes all L. The frozen verifier was inspected, not run.
